summary: Fixed all nine review items; VM clippy, 265 tests, and wasm checks passed.
body:
Changed files: `scene/import.rs`, `import/{graphic,group,meta,transition,s6_tests,tests}.rs`. All are formatted. Five new modules remain untracked; include them during integration.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import(bytes: &[u8], opts: &ImportOptions)
    -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;
```

Internal cleanup remains:

```rust
pub(crate) fn drop_overlays(
    imported: &mut Imported,
    overlays: &[Overlay],
) -> Result<()>;
```

Design decisions:

- Transitions use nominal occupancy and resolved cuts. Source in-points compensate for trimmed handles; nested sources retain pre-roll separately from carrier start. Nominal spans feed `stack::assign`; bounded paint-order constraints place transition pairs jointly. An impossible pair does not prevent independent valid dissolves. This follows XSD `transitionType` and `scene/export.rs`’s nominal-edge/window representation. A/B dissolve export→import now preserves the transition window.
- Clock-only nests retain child opacity and have 100% boundary opacity. Native children normalize opacity against the nearest isolated ancestor, following XSD `groupType@isolate` and `@timeScale`.
- Isolated subtrees containing overlays are preserved together, promoted to the outermost isolated ancestor. Thus baked opacity is applied once: the regression verifies 50% baked alpha and a 100% native carrier. This trades native editability for correct compositing.
- Nest source clocks and audio carriers retain exact Tick boundaries. Video snaps separately; collapsed video carriers retain nonempty audio.
- Native nesting is capped at eight, matching `crates/render/src/lib.rs::MAX_NEST_DEPTH`. Deeper content becomes a reported overlay. The ten-group test verifies a reachable leaf within the native limit.
- AudioMix converts endpoints and marker offsets to Tick before arithmetic. Playback duration uses checked exact binary-rational division; loops share integer boundaries. Semantics follow XSD `audioTrackType`.
- Overlay removal also removes transitions referencing deleted ClipIds.
- XSD `characterStyle@font` defines an ordered family list. The pure importer retains the first family for runtime resolution and reports the unsupported fallback chain; it cannot inspect installed fonts.
- Span text concatenates every text-node child in document order, preserving whitespace around comments.

No new external code was borrowed. The prior implementation consulted `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-vector/src/shapes.rs`; no copied code, dependencies, or assets were added. Resolve, stack, and export remain unchanged. Existing overlay audio limitations remain explicitly reported.

TDD evidence—all regressions below are green:

| Item | Regression (`scene_` prefix) | Observed red assertion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `fix1_dissolve_occupancy_and_roundtrip` | Incoming start/source-in were 3s/1s; expected 4s/2s |
| 1 | `fix1_joint_track_and_one_sided_edges` | One-sided handle changed nominal clip edges |
| 1 | `fix1_conflict_does_not_break_other_pair` | Zero transitions; expected one independent valid dissolve |
| 2 | `fix2_overlay_effective_opacity` | Isolated carrier referenced a nest instead of the complete overlay |
| 3 | `fix3_clock_only_opacity` | Child opacity 100%; expected 50% |
| 4 | `fix4_nested_audio_exact_edges` | Nonempty audio carrier missing |
| 5 | `fix5_deep_content_reachable` | Native depth reached nine |
| 6 | `fix6_audio_loops_adjacent_ticks` | Adjacent boundaries overlapped by four Ticks |
| 6 | `fix6_audio_rational_duration` | Duration eleven Ticks short |
| 7 | `fix7_drop_overlay_transitions` | Dangling transition endpoint |
| 8 | `fix8_font_family_list` | Literal `'Arial', Inter`; expected `Arial` |
| 9 | `fix9_span_comment_text` | `One`; expected `One two` |

Additional passing checks cover nested transition pre-roll and clock-only nests inside isolation. Fixture corrections addressed schema duration limits, disabled duration-carrier counting, and half-even frame snapping.

Logs: [initial red](/tmp/import2-fix-red.log), [independent-pair red](/tmp/import2-fix-red2.log), [rational-duration red](/tmp/import2-fix-red3.log), [final green gate](/tmp/import2-fix-final2.log).
